meta.name: derisk-measurement-advisor
meta.description: Identify what to measure, test, or track to de-risk a product or AI idea. Use when stress-testing an idea across internal (DUFV) and external (PESTEL) dimensions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 识别产品风险并确定测量指标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统性地评估产品或AI创意的风险并确定关键指标。
copy.tagline_en: Identify risks and define metrics for your product or AI idea
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically de-risk a product or AI idea by identifying what to measure and track.

howto.what: 装上后，它会进行约 15-20 分钟的风险扫描：先问 4 个背景问题，再按 10 个内部与外部风险维度逐项提问，让你选关键指标，把每个风险标为“立即行动”或“开始跟踪”，最后给出优先级风险清单。
howto.when: 当你针对具体产品或人工智能想法，请求做风险扫描、找出该测量/测试什么，或要求评估内部与外部风险时触发。典型如询问“这个想法要不要做”或“上线前要盯哪些风险”。

say.text: 帮我扫描一下我这个产品想法的风险。
say.note: Claude 会先问 4 个背景问题。

say.text: 这个 AI 想法值得做吗？该测什么？
say.note: 会走 10 维度扫描并给出行动/跟踪分类。

say.text: 上线前有哪些内部和外部风险要盯？
say.note: 会生成带优先级的风险登记册。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a risk-scan advisor: after 4 context questions, it walks through 10 risk dimensions (DUFV + PESTEL), asks you to pick key measures, classifies each risk as act-now or watch, and outputs a prioritized risk register.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe a concrete product or AI idea and ask for a risk scan, what to measure/test, or internal/external stress testing — e.g., 'is this idea worth it?'.

say_en.text: Help me scan the risks of my product idea.
say_en.note: Claude will ask 4 context questions first.

say_en.text: Is this AI idea worth it? What should we test?
say_en.note: Runs 10-dimension scan, labels each risk act/watch.

say_en.text: What internal and external risks should we watch before launch?
